title: RAW UNREVIEWED: an explicitly named exception inside an owner-keyed rule list
summary: Seek a public historical rule table whose source itself names a general class and one or more exceptions, with stable entry identifiers. A target reading must predict both the ordinary and exceptional clauses on admitted pages, including negation and scope. An attractive shared class label without the source exception is insufficient. Source, ownership, and target capacity are unverified.

design.mechanism: explicit source exception binds a class term and its scoped negation
design.unit: entire keyed rule list and complete candidate paragraph
design.contrast: exception-sensitive reading versus flat class-name or co-occurrence reading
design.prediction: the same candidate word retains its class meaning while a distinct, prelocated target construction accounts for each source-written exception
